integrity: All numerical claims are determined by explicit exhaustive checks with two independently implemented verification scripts and a complete state-and-edge certificate. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite Pappus graph only; 486-state distance claims rely on reproducible exhaustive enumeration and do not generalize to all biaffine planes. Literature novelty comparison is not exhaustive.
title: Edge-metric bases of the Pappus graph and their disconnected exchange geometry
